title: プログラミング基礎Ⅰ(再履修クラス)
subtitle: Programming Basics I
educationalGoal: Students will learn the basics of the C programming language, as computer programs are essential for developing intelligent robots, and in particular for implementing motion control and environmental information acquisition. Consider how programming can play a role in regional cooperation.
advice: This is a basic course on the C language. We will cover the following topics: 1. Creating and running a computer program 2. Input and output 3. Variables 4. Conditional branching and iteration 5. Arrays 6. Functions Students are expected to actively participate in class. Students are expected to complete exercises independently. Students are required to bring their own laptop computers for use in exercises. Students are required to be aware of the instructor's messages in the class and to check for messages/materials on the KIT Inside website before every class because the course schedule may change depending on the class progress.

activityGoals.body: Understand the basic grammar of the C language and how textbook example-level programs work.
Create and run a textbook example-level program.
